what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in Zambia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 64792 of these refugees in Zambia, 5.5% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the country, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in periods from 1977, at war level in many years, and in every year from 2016 to 2025.
From 2016 to 2025 the opponents it records include Kamuina Nsapu, RNL, CNPSC and M23, and it also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1975 at 60 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 66248, at the end of 2004, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1999 to 2008 and 2017 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Zambia.
These are year-end totals for Zambia only, reported to UNHCR.
